output.contract_title: SaaS Subscription Agreement with Enterprise Partner 008 LLC

clauses.clause_text: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoice amounts within thirty (30) days of invoice date.
Vendor shall notify Customer in writing within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of any confirmed Data Breach.
Each party's maximum aggregate liability shall be strictly limited to the total fees paid under this Agreement in the preceding twelve (12) months.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon providing thirty (30) days prior written notice.
This Agreement renews on an annual basis unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 30 days prior.

extraction_notes: Document extracted once for downstream policy comparison

mandatory_requirements.description: Payment terms shall not exceed Net 45 days from receipt of undisputed invoice.
mandatory_requirements.threshold: Maximum of 45 calendar days after the date the invoice is received and deemed undisputed.

recommended_requirements.description: Late payment penalties should not exceed 1.5% per month.
recommended_requirements.threshold: Cap of 1.5% interest per month on overdue amounts.

ambiguities_in_policy: Definition of "undisputed invoice" – the policy does not specify the criteria or process for determining when an invoice is undisputed.
Whether "Net 45 days" refers to calendar days or business days is not clarified.
The calculation basis for the 1.5% monthly penalty (e.g., on the original invoice amount, the outstanding balance, or including previously accrued penalties) is not defined.
The policy does not address how penalties are applied if payments are partially late (e.g., partial payments before the due date).

mappings.justification: Clause requires payment within 30 days of invoice date, which is stricter than the policy maximum of 45 days.
Clause addresses data breach notification, not payment terms.
Clause pertains to liability caps, unrelated to the payment terms policy.
Clause deals with termination rights, not payment terms.
Clause concerns renewal provisions, unrelated to payment terms.

risk_findings.ambiguity_description: The term "undisputed invoice amounts" is undefined, creating uncertainty about payment obligations for disputed invoices. No interest or penalty provisions for late payment are included, potentially favoring the vendor.

"Becoming aware of any confirmed Data Breach" is not defined, leaving room for interpretation of when a breach is considered "confirmed" and when the vendor is deemed aware. This may delay notification beyond the intended 24‑hour window.

Limiting aggregate liability to the total fees paid in the preceding twelve months may be insufficient to cover consequential or regulatory damages, exposing the customer to significant uncovered risk.
The termination clause lacks provisions for post‑termination duties such as data return, transition assistance, or outstanding obligations, creating operational uncertainty upon termination.

The renewal provision does not specify how renewal terms (e.g., pricing, service scope) will be determined, nor does it define the method for delivering the non‑renewal notice, leading to potential unexpected changes at renewal.
